providers.message: Codex is not authenticated. Run `codex login` and try again.

Claude Code isn't installed on the server, or the server can't find `claude`. It looked in ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, /usr/bin. Install Claude Code on the server (then open a new terminal there to check `claude --version` works), or start the server with DOMOVOI_CLAUDE_BINARY=/path/to/claude.
Domovoi needs OpenCode 2.0.18 or newer (found 1.14.19). Install it with `npm install -g @opencode/cli`.
